design_informed_by: user hypothesis of cumulative undertraining and annual seasonality
objective: Test whether explicit annual memory improves the same one-month-ahead sequential BMA chain without learning absolute interannual trade levels.

source.cell: flow x CN8 x partner country
source.raw_storage: one monthly archive in RAM at a time; no durable raw ZIP

targets.participation: Bernoulli participation with seasonal deviation on logit scale
targets.statistical_unit_value: log(statistical_value_eur_per_kg) innovation relative to M0; not a transaction price

models.M0: v0.6.4 sequential ordinary model, decisionally exact after efficiency refactor
models.M1: M0 plus annual Fourier harmonics k=1 and k=2
models.M2: M1 plus zero-sum monthly residual with partial pooling global -> flow -> CN4 -> partner -> cell only with frozen support
models.mixture: target-specific prequential Bayesian model weights updated only after adjudication

primary_metrics.reporting_unit: target month first; microaggregates diagnostic only

adjudication_gates.SEASONAL_INFORMATIVE_TARGET: Seasonal mixture has better cumulative prequential log score than M0 separately in 2023 and 2024, and its target-specific point loss is not worse than M0 over combined 2023-2024.
adjudication_gates.SEASONAL_STABLE: The phase-specific seasonal posterior preserves direction across the 2023 and 2024 recurrences without any high-confidence phase reversal; report posterior overlap and phase vector similarity rather than substituting absolute levels.
adjudication_gates.LOCAL_ONLY: Gate passes only for an explicitly supported hierarchy and claim key.
adjudication_gates.ABSTAIN_LOW_SUPPORT: Frozen support gate in the software addendum is not met.
adjudication_gates.ABSTAIN_UNSTABLE_PHASE: Recurrence direction or phase is incompatible across years.
adjudication_gates.YEAR_END_UNCALIBRATED: December remains separate until recurrent calibration supports ordinary treatment.
adjudication_gates.NO_PROMOTION: Retrospective gains do not authorize prospective, industrial, operational or BIND readiness claims.

required_items: source hashes for engine, connector, runner and tests
exact support thresholds for each hierarchy level
weight update equations and numerical floors
expected artifact tree and manifest contract

training_age_extension.permitted_design_after_primary_campaign: Compare causally accumulated chains of different posterior age on calendar-phase-aligned evaluation blocks; never pool N months into one training observation or evaluate an N-month fit on only one target month.
training_age_extension.add_earlier_year_only_if: It changes recurrence identification, December calibration, hierarchy stability, or discrimination between undertraining and seasonality.
